notes.title: Content Update - Indian museums in Kubits Gallery!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Mu_M7Xc8c7k;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi,

Thank you for playing and enjoying Kubits Gallery, here is the first free content update for the game today:

- Two new museums with beautiful paintings from India! First museum is the colored Holi Festival and then of course the Yogallery
- 30 new levels to play
- A few french translation mistakes corrected

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871479/97b818cbfa301873b95e51e3a78abb0af7f81044.png[/img]

Have fun!

Edwin, NoLAN Games.

notes.title: Demo day-one patch
notes.content:
Hi,

A little day-one patch for the demo, here are the changes:

- Cross removes square setting now always removes square
- New setting for Square removes Cross added
- Fixed a music bug when restarting an already won picross
- Win sound (fireworks) is less loud now
- Done numbers are more transparent
[strike]- Hidden picross?[/strike]

Thank you to everyone who played and enjoyed the demo, and to everyone who gave me your feedbacks it's always appreciated.

Have fun,
Edwin.
